provenance.prompt: Genre: video game soundtrack, dark ambient piano with a slow, soft pulse. BPM: 76. Key: D minor. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. Setting: Pine Hollow at night, an eerie folklore forest - lanterns glowing between black pines, fog on the ground, something old watching from the trees; hushed and unsettling, never scary. Arrangement: a sparse, haunting grand-piano melody in the low-middle register with long rests, over a cold string drone and a faint music-box shimmer; a warm upright bass and a soft, steady heartbeat pulse of felt kick, brushed snare and low tom run under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: close felt piano, dark wooden-room reverb.

Genre: video game boss battle music, dark cinematic piano and strings. BPM: 120. Key: D minor. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. The fight with the Antler King, an ancient forest guardian gone wrong, in a fog-filled clearing of standing stones and hanging lanterns - relentless, ominous, heroic underneath. Arrangement: a driving, hammered low-piano ostinato and a dark piano melody in octaves, over urgent string stabs; a heavy bass and a powerful, steady groove of taiko, kick, snare and toms runs under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: big, close and punchy, dark hall reverb.

Genre: video game victory and dawn theme, cinematic piano. BPM: 84. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. The quest's end: the Antler King is laid to rest and the first light of dawn rises over Pine Hollow, the fog lifting from the pines - relief, warmth, quiet triumph.
